reading.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
reading.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

news.title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
news.summary: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.
